summary: Indian stocks head into Thursday on a firm footing after a strong post-holiday session, with strong after-hours results, an MSCI index review overnight and US rate worries in the mix.

detail.leaders: Banks after a strong session; Tata Power on its results
detail.laggards: IT and healthcare, which lagged into the close
detail.tone: A forward-looking read: nothing is trading in India. The setup is a little less buoyant than at the close as US rate-hike bets firm, but supportive results and foreign buying keep the bias positive.
